checkpointRule: Return every five completed families, or every two hours, whichever comes first. This lane carries one family, so it checkpoints once.

checkpoints.note: DJ-LE-250B built as a measured flat overlay onto a ruled table: thirty-three cells, each bounded by four strokes read from the page content stream and re-checked against the pinned binary, ten participant facts written and read back from the finalized bytes at those cells, canonical and boundary fixtures rendered and every page rastered. All nine counters zero by the builder's own count. A factual claim about the fingerprint boxes was found wrong on visual review and corrected in the builder and in this lane's row. Not verified here.

timestampBasis: The checkpoint time is the modification time of the family's build-status.json on the build host, which is when the build that produced it finished.
